comment:
* This class is used internally by the Protocol Buffer library and generated
 * message implementations.  It is public only because those generated messages
 * do not reside in the {@code protobuf} package.  Others should not use this
 * class directly.
 *
 * This class contains constants and helper functions useful for dealing with
 * the Protocol Buffer wire format.
 *
 * @author kenton@google.com Kenton Varda

methods.name: static int getTagWireType(final int tag)
methods.comment: Given a tag value, determines the wire type (the lower 3 bits).

methods.name: public static int getTagFieldNumber(final int tag)
methods.comment: Given a tag value, determines the field number (the upper 29 bits).

methods.name: static int makeTag(final int fieldNumber, final int wireType)
methods.comment: Makes a tag value given a field number and wire type.

methods.name: public static boolean parseUnknownField(final CodedInputByteBufferNano input, final int tag) throws IOException
methods.comment:
* Parses an unknown field. This implementation skips the field. * *

Generated messages will call this for unknown fields if the store_unknown_fields * option is off. * * @return {@literal true} unless the tag is an end-group tag.

methods.name: public static final int getRepeatedFieldArrayLength(final CodedInputByteBufferNano input, final int tag) throws IOException
methods.comment:
* Computes the array length of a repeated field. We assume that in the common case repeated
   * fields are contiguously serialized but we still correctly handle interspersed values of a
   * repeated field (but with extra allocations).
   *
   * Rewinds to current input position before returning.
   *
   * @param input stream input, pointing to the byte after the first tag
   * @param tag repeated field tag just read
   * @return length of array
   * @throws IOException
